items.source_en:
My assessment is that a Six Sisters mining crew could inhabit this area for a considerable length of time without suffering any ill effects. The atmosphere is oxygen-rich, and the soil does not contain harmful substances. 

My suggestion for future supervisors is to begin excavating on this site, and move northeast once the resources here are tapped. I've found some rock solid evidence (no pun intended) that there are rich iron deposits in that direction. 

Hopefully this helps. I wish you all the best. Your jobs are a lot harder than mine. 

Elliot


PROPERTY OF SIX SISTERS. GEOLOGICAL SURVEY DATA IS PROPRIETARY AND CONFIDENTIAL
